verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships first-party AuthKit SDKs for Next.js, Astro, TanStack Start, React and Laravel. The Astro SDK explicitly documents session validation and route protection, and the Next.js SDK documents server-side session management helpers. The evidence never mentions middleware or edge-runtime session verification, so the edge element of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented Next.js middleware for route protection, explicit edge-runtime session verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect routes with first-party framework SDKs and middleware (Next.js and peers) that verify sessions at the edge

citations.quote: Session validation, automatic token refresh, PKCE sign-in, route protection, auth components, and a client-island auth store
The AuthKit Next.js SDK provides server-side and client-side utilities for integrating AuthKit authentication into Next.js applications.
The AuthKit library for Next.js provides convenient helpers for authentication and session management using WorkOS & AuthKit with Next.js.
